_note: Words for Admin > Custom branding. Edit the wording here. {name} is filled in by the app.
intro: Customise Mail App with your organisation's brand identity. Your logo, name and brand colour will be applied across the entire workspace for all users.
logoHint: Upload a PNG, SVG or WebP file (maximum 200 KB). A square format is recommended, as it will also be used as the application icon on mobile devices, tablets and desktop app shortcuts.
logoTooBig: That logo is over 200 KB. Please use a smaller file.
logoWrongType: Please use a PNG, SVG or WebP file.
name: Application name
nameHint: Replaces all references to "Mail App" across the navigation menu, browser tab title and installed progressive web app (PWA) labels. For example: Smith & Jones Mail.
colourHint: Applied to primary action buttons, the selected menu item and unread counts. Select a preset or enter a custom hex value (e.g. #0F766E).
colourDarkened: That colour is too light for white writing, so buttons use a slightly darker shade.
supportHint: The destination for built-in help and support links, routing user queries directly to your internal team rather than to Mail App's help pages. If left unconfigured, general support links remain hidden for non-administrator users.
appNote: Once custom branding is applied, Mail App's own help links and version number are hidden from standard members and visible only to admins.
saved: Branding saved. Reloading to show it everywhere…
reset: Back to the Mail App look
resetDone: Back to the Mail App look. Reloading…
failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
badEmail: That support address doesn't look right. Please check it.
